entries.text: 哦，这是讽刺吗？你到底想不想救我出去！？
entries.source_text: 哦，这是讽刺吗？你到底想不想救我出去！？

entries.text: Yeah. Just hold on, and when you see the door open, run for it.

entries.text: I'm going to fight the Khan leader in exchange for your freedom.
entries.source_text: I'm going to fight the Khan leader in exchange for your freedom.

entries.text: Agatha's the oldest one here.  We all love her, especially # her stories.  Go by and see her if you want a good yarn.

entries.text: 阿加莎是这里年纪最大的。我们都喜欢她，尤其是她的故事。如果你想听有趣的故事就去找她。

I've actually seen one, even if it was from far away. They're
 # nasty creatures, with claws and a big stinger.  And their poison can be
 # deadly if it isn't treated.  You should talk to my dad, Aradesh, he knows
 # more about them.

entries.text: 我真的远远地见到过一只呢。它们是肮脏的动物，有巨大的爪子和锋利的毒刺，它们的毒即使处理过仍然会致命。你该去问我爸爸，亚拉德什，他知道它们的一些情况。
entries.source_text: 我真的远远地见到过一只呢。它们是肮脏的动物，有巨大的爪子和锋利的毒刺，它们的毒即使处理过仍然会致命。你该去问我爸爸，亚拉德什，他知道它们的一些情况。

entries.text: Pretty bad bunch or so I've heard.  My father knows more # about them.  He never tells me much about the outside world.
entries.source_text:
Pretty bad bunch or so I've heard.  My father knows more

entries.text: 我听说是很坏很坏的一帮子家伙。我爸爸知道更多他们事。但他从不告诉我外面的事情。
